findings.message: Codebook 0 does not start with the sync pattern 0x564342 but 0x424242; decoders refuse the setup header, and its audio packets are only counted.
The codeword lengths of codebook 0 ask for more codewords than a prefix code of those lengths holds; libvorbis 1.3.7 refuses to decode the stream.
The codeword lengths of codebook 0 leave codewords unused, an incomplete prefix code; libvorbis 1.3.7 refuses to decode the stream.
Codebook 1 has 32768 dimensions and 1024 entries, more than libvorbis 1.3.7 accepts (ilog of both above 24 together); it refuses the setup header.
Floor 0 has the type 2; the specification defines types 0 and 1 (section 4.2.4), so the setup header cannot be read further.
Mode 1 uses mapping 1, but the setup header has 1 mapping; decoders refuse it.
The setup header's framing bit is 0; libvorbis 1.3.7 refuses the header.
